calibration.ftp_source: Calibrated from race data: 195W avg for 80min in May 2025 race + 205W NP in training (Mar 2022)

structure_corrections: Wed/Thu swapped: Strength+Swim on Wed as recovery buffer. Quality run on Thu with fresh legs.
Gradual strength: 1 session/week (Wed only) for Wks 1-3, then 2 sessions (Wed+Sat) from Wk 4.
Saturday run capped at easy Z1 in peak weeks (6 & 8) when Thu already carries threshold run.

Z1_Z2.name: Easy
Z1_Z2.note: Mandatory pace for all easy runs

weeks.note: Establish structure. 1 strength session (Wed only). Correct easy run pace.

sessions.name: W01 Tue – Z2 Endurance
sessions.description: 60min aerobic base. 10min warmup, 40min Z2 (114-153W), 10min cooldown. First session at corrected FTP=205W zones.

sessions.name: W01 Wed – Strength A + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine A (30min) + 25min easy swim. Recovery buffer between Tuesday bike and Thursday run.

sessions.name: W01 Thu – Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.description: 45min easy aerobic run. HR under 137bpm, pace above 6:45/km. Walk if HR drifts. Foundation building.

sessions.name: W01 Fri – Optional Z2 Endurance
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. 45min easy Z2. Skip without guilt if fatigued. Saturday has combined session.

sessions.name: W01 Sat – Easy Run
sessions.description: 25min easy run. HR under 137bpm, pace above 6:45/km. No strength this week (Week 1-3 = one strength session only).

sessions.name: W01 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h @ Z2-Z3 (114-178W). Stay with the bunch. Do not chase attacks. Eat every 45min.

weeks.note: First threshold bike intervals. 1 strength session.

sessions.name: W02 Tue – Threshold 4×7min
sessions.description: 60min. 12min warmup → 4×7min @ Z4 (180-194W) with 4min Z1 recovery → 12min cooldown. First real threshold intervals at corrected FTP. Will feel harder than recent rides — that is correct.

sessions.name: W02 Wed – Strength B + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine B (30min) + 30min swim (200m easy, 5×100m moderate with 20sec rest, 100m easy). Recovery buffer.

sessions.name: W02 Thu – Aerobic Run + Strides
sessions.description: 50min. 42min easy @ Z1/Z2 (>6:45/km, <137bpm). Then 4×15sec strides with full walk recovery. Strides = brief accelerations to ~80% top speed, not sprints. Walk fully between each.

sessions.name: W02 Fri – Optional Z2
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. 45min easy Z2. Good option if Tuesday felt manageable.

sessions.name: W02 Sat – Easy Run
sessions.description: 25min easy. HR under 137bpm, pace above 6:45/km. Focus on running form.

sessions.name: W02 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h @ Z2-Z3.

weeks.note: Longer threshold + first tempo run. 1 strength session.

sessions.name: W03 Tue – Threshold 3×10min
sessions.description: 60min. 12min warmup → 3×10min @ Z4 (180-194W) with 5min Z1 recovery → 13min cooldown. Core FTP-building session.

sessions.name: W03 Wed – Strength A + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine A (30min) + 32min swim (200m easy, 8×50m moderate with 15sec rest, 200m easy).

sessions.name: W03 Thu – Tempo 2×10min
sessions.description: 55min. 12min easy warmup → 2×10min @ Z3 tempo (6:05-6:30/km) with 5min easy jog recovery → 18min easy cooldown. First pace above current race speed.

sessions.name: W03 Fri – Optional Z2/Z3
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. 50min: 10min warmup → 2×10min @ Z3 (155-178W) with 5min Z1 between → 15min easy cooldown.

sessions.name: W03 Sat – Short Tempo Run
sessions.description: 28min. 8min easy warmup → 12min @ Z3 tempo (6:05-6:25/km) → 8min easy cooldown. Two quality run sessions this week. No strength (Week 1-3 = one strength session only).

sessions.name: W03 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h @ Z2-Z3.

weeks.note: VO2max bike + run intervals. 2nd strength begins (Wed+Sat).

sessions.name: W04 Tue – VO2max 5×4min
sessions.description: 60min. 15min warmup (incl. 3×1min Z4 primers at 3min, 7min, 11min) → 5×4min @ Z5 (196-217W) with 4min Z1 recovery → 13min cooldown. Very hard — shorten to 3min if power drops below 194W in reps 4-5.

sessions.name: W04 Wed – Strength B + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine B (30min) + 35min swim (300m easy, 6×100m with 20sec rest, 150m easy). Active recovery after Tuesday VO2max.

sessions.name: W04 Thu – Intervals 4×1km
sessions.description: 55min. 12min easy warmup → 4×1km @ Z4 (5:40-6:00/km) with 2min easy jog recovery → 19min easy cooldown. First race-pace running. Focus on smooth form. 1km = ~350-360sec at target pace.

sessions.name: W04 Fri – Optional Easy Spin
sessions.description: OPTIONAL — lean towards skipping this week. VO2max Tuesday + intervals Thursday is significant load. If riding: 35min easy Z1/Z2 only (under 153W).

sessions.name: W04 Sat – Easy Run (before Strength A)
sessions.description: 20min very easy Z1 (>6:45/km). Then Strength Routine A (25min). Run first — arrives at weights with reasonable legs. Total ~45min.

sessions.name: W04 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h @ Z2-Z3. May feel the VO2max work from Tuesday. Ride within yourself.

weeks.note: First brick (Fri). 2 strength sessions. Brick = 2nd bike + 2nd run.

sessions.name: W05 Tue – Threshold/VO2 Mix
sessions.description: 60min. 12min warmup → 2×8min @ Z4 (180-194W) with 4min Z1 → 3×3min @ Z5 (196-217W) with 4min Z1 → 14min cooldown. Mixed intensity mirrors late-race demands.

sessions.name: W05 Wed – Strength B + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine B (30min) + 35min swim (200m easy, 4×150m moderate with 25sec rest, 200m easy).

sessions.name: W05 Thu – Tempo 3×8min
sessions.description: 55min. 12min easy warmup → 3×8min @ Z3 tempo (6:05-6:25/km) with 4min easy jog recovery → 11min easy cooldown.

sessions.name: W05 Fri – Brick Bike (25min @ Z4)
sessions.description: OPTIONAL but recommended. 25min @ Z4 (180-194W) — race effort. Transition immediately to brick run within 90sec. No cooldown on bike.

sessions.name: W05 Fri – Brick Run (20min @ Z3-Z4)
sessions.description: Immediately after brick bike. 20min @ Z3-Z4 (5:55-6:20/km). Heavy legs in first 3-5min are normal — this is the race-transition feeling you are training. Counts as second run this week.

sessions.name: W05 Sat – Strength A only
sessions.description: Strength Routine A (25min). No run — Friday brick provided the second run. Focused and efficient.

sessions.name: W05 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h @ Z2-Z3. Fuel well — loaded week.

weeks.note: Peak load. Sweet-spot + threshold run. Sat run = easy Z1 only.

sessions.name: W06 Tue – Sweet Spot 2×18min
sessions.description: 60min. 10min warmup → 2×18min @ sweet-spot (180-193W, 88-94% FTP) with 5min Z1 between → 9min cooldown. Your 2025 race averaged 195W — exactly this zone. Most race-specific bike session in the plan.

sessions.name: W06 Wed – Strength B + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine B (30min) + 40min swim (300m easy, 6×100m Z3 with 20sec rest, 4×50m harder with 30sec rest, 100m easy).

sessions.name: W06 Thu – Threshold 5×1km
sessions.description: 58min. 12min easy warmup → 5×1km @ Z4 (5:40-6:00/km) with 90sec easy jog recovery → 16min easy cooldown. Faster than race pace to make race pace feel easier. Peak quality run of the plan.

sessions.name: W06 Fri – Optional Easy Z2
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. Peak load week — only if legs genuinely feel good after Thursday threshold run. 40min easy Z2 (114-153W). If in doubt, skip.

sessions.name: W06 Sat – Easy Run (before Strength A)
sessions.description: 20min easy Z1 ONLY (>6:45/km). Thursday carried the quality run this week. No pace targets on Saturday. Then Strength Routine A (25min). Resist adding pace — it undermines Thursday adaptation.

sessions.name: W06 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h. Biggest week — eat well and ride within yourself.

weeks.note: Volume -35%. Strength back to 1 session (Wed only).

sessions.name: W07 Tue – Easy + Openers
sessions.description: 50min. Easy spin with 2×8min @ Z3 (155-178W) to maintain sharpness. No hard efforts. Recovery week.

sessions.name: W07 Wed – Strength A (reduced) + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine A, 2 sets only (20-25min). Swim: 25min easy continuous, no intervals. Recovery week.

sessions.name: W07 Thu – Easy Run
sessions.description: 40min easy. Below 137bpm throughout. Recovery week — nothing more.

sessions.name: W07 Fri – Optional Recovery Spin
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. 35min very easy Z1/Z2 (under 153W). No structure. Skip if in doubt.

sessions.name: W07 Sat – Very Easy Run (no strength)
sessions.description: 20min very easy Z1 (>7:00/km). Recovery week — one strength session only (Wednesday). No Saturday strength.

sessions.name: W07 Sun – Group Ride (~3h, easy)
sessions.description: Sunday group ride ~3h. Ride easy, chat, enjoy. No chasing. Z2 only.

weeks.note: Post-recovery sharpening. Peak brick (Fri). 2 strength sessions.

sessions.name: W08 Tue – VO2max 6×3.5min
sessions.description: 60min. 15min warmup (incl. 2×2min Z4 primers) → 6×3.5min @ Z5 (196-217W) with 3.5min Z1 recovery → 12min cooldown. Highest intensity bike session. Stop at 5 reps if power drops below 194W.

sessions.name: W08 Wed – Strength B + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine B (30min) + 40min swim (400m easy, 8×100m steady with 20sec rest, 200m easy).

sessions.name: W08 Thu – Threshold 6×800m
sessions.description: 55min. 10min easy warmup → 6×800m @ Z4 (5:35-5:55/km) with 90sec easy jog recovery → 15min easy cooldown. Shorter, sharper reps than Week 6 — race-sharpening. 800m at target pace = ~275-285sec.

sessions.name: W08 Fri – Brick Bike (20min @ Z4)
sessions.description: OPTIONAL but strongly recommended. 20min @ Z4 (180-194W) — race effort. Transition immediately to brick run within 90sec. Closest race rehearsal in the plan.

sessions.name: W08 Fri – Brick Run (20min @ race pace)
sessions.description: Immediately after brick bike. 20min @ race target pace (5:55-6:10/km). Your 2025 race: 195W bike / 6:19 run. Today you practice hitting that pace. Notice how quickly legs find rhythm vs Week 5.

sessions.name: W08 Sat – Strength A only
sessions.description: Strength Routine A (25min). No run — Friday brick covered it.

sessions.name: W08 Sun – Group Ride (~3h)
sessions.description: Final big group ride. Trust the fitness — it is there.

weeks.note: Volume -35%. 1 strength session. Sat run = easy only.

sessions.name: W09 Tue – Taper Intervals 3×6min
sessions.description: 50min. 12min warmup → 3×6min @ Z4-Z5 (180-196W) with 5min Z1 between → 11min cooldown. Volume down, quality stays high. Legs should feel springy.

sessions.name: W09 Wed – Strength A (light) + Swim
sessions.description: Strength Routine A, 2 sets only, lighter weight (20min). Swim: 28min (300m warmup, 4×100m steady, 150m easy). One strength session only this week.

sessions.name: W09 Thu – Race Pace Openers
sessions.description: 42min. 12min easy → 3×3min @ race target pace (5:55-6:10/km) with 2min easy jog recovery → 18min easy cooldown. Short, purposeful, sharp.

sessions.name: W09 Fri – Taper Spin
sessions.description: OPTIONAL. 35min easy with 2×5min @ Z3 (155-178W) to keep legs sharp. Skip if in doubt — race in 9 days.

sessions.name: W09 Sat – Very Easy Run (no strength)
sessions.description: 20min very easy Z1 (>7:00/km). Taper week — one strength session only. No Saturday strength.

sessions.name: W09 Sun – Group Ride (Shorter, ~2-2.5h)
sessions.description: Shorter group ride ~2-2.5h. Ride Z2 only, NP under 150W. Tell the group you are tapering.

weeks.note: No strength. One easy bike, run, swim. Then race.

sessions.name: W10 Tue – Leg Activation
sessions.description: 35min. 10min easy → 3×4min @ Z3-Z4 (178-194W) with 4min Z1 between → 7min easy. Wake legs up without fatiguing them.

sessions.name: W10 Wed – Easy Swim Activation
sessions.description: 20min easy swim only. Relaxed and smooth. No strength this week.

sessions.name: W10 Thu – Easy Run + Strides
sessions.description: 25min. 20min easy (>6:45/km) → 4×15sec strides with full walk recovery. Legs should feel light and quick. Last run before race.

sessions.name: W10 Fri – REST
sessions.description: Rest. Pack race bag. Eat extra carbs from dinner.

sessions.name: W10 Sat – REST / Race Prep
sessions.description: REST. If race today: 10min easy swim + 5min easy jog warmup. If race tomorrow: full rest, sleep early.

sessions.name: W10 Sun – RACE DAY 🏁
sessions.description: 1.5km Swim + 40km Bike + 10km Run. Swim: easy first 300m. Bike: 180-194W NP. Run: first 2km at 6:10-6:20/km then build to 5:55-6:10/km.
